story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound 834 date elements and support Facets transaction effective date population

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field for id 'TC_TS001_003' is 'Edge', but Test Step Expected Result text shows no error, rejection, or absent record in examples such as 'The transmission processes successfully with no blocking error and the canonical attachment is available for review.' and 'A row is returned for SBEL_EFF_DT = 2025-01-01, confirming the first candidate date was used for the transaction effective date.'

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility span begins regardless of Assessment Date
Use Assessment Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS003_003 is "Edge" but Test Step Expected Result text contains no error, rejection, or absent-record result. Example expected results: "The transmission itself shows successful file-level processing with Disposition = Completed and Validation Status = Accepted, allowing boundary-condition verification downstream.", "No new transaction effective date driven by a changed Assessment Date is displayed for this update because the Assessment Date did not change.", "The post-processing FACETS eligibility data matches the pre-file baseline for transaction effective date selection, showing the unchanged Assessment Date did not trigger a new effective-date update."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date and retain relevant field values when only Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: edge case never tests a failure outcome

gaps: Status field for TC_TS004_003 is "Edge", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The duplicate file may complete transport-level processing and archive handling, but this does not confirm creation of a new eligibility change."

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for relevant field changes received before eligibility start when Assessment Date is unchanged
Use Maintenance Date only for current eligibility relevant field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged

flagged.why: edge case never tests rejection or absence

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS006_003 is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record; examples include step 8 Expected Result "The transaction is traceable in TM, but the boundary condition does not prove a post-begin maintenance-date split and therefore requires absence validation in FACETS." and step 16 Expected Result "The boundary test completes with full audit evidence. The update does not create a new current eligibility effective date or an additional FACETS eligibility row when DTP*303 is equal to the existing eligibility begin date, confirming Maintenance Date is only used in the specified condition."
